property_summary: For any target address and value, the reference contract C never reverts the sendMoney call when the callee's fallback reverts (it returns/consumes the call failure silently and leaves C's balance decreased when value was sent), whereas the mutated version reverts on a failing external call — so the universal property: calling sendMoney to a target whose fallback reverts never causes the reference C to revert (call completes), but the mutant will revert for some inputs (value > 0).
change_summary: Replace low-level call with a checked call that reverts on failure, changing whether funds/state remain modified when target call fails.
